culture.text: Trading firm of about 2,501 staff, headquartered in Chicago; trades many asset classes, from seconds to years.
Says it mixes start-up spirit with an established firm's stability: high expectations, curiosity and constant collaboration, with results rewarded.
Staff mostly studied computer science, finance, economics or maths at schools like UIUC, McGill and the University of Chicago.
